title: FerrFlow Version Manifest
description: Single-file source of truth for per-package versions, written by `ferrflow release` when workspace.manifest_file is configured. Lists the current version of every configured package as of the last release.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocompletion.

packages.description: Map of package name to its current version. Sorted alphabetically for deterministic diffs.

additionalProperties.description: The current version of the package.

released_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the manifest was written.

commit.description: Short SHA of the release commit (or HEAD at write time).
